Exit code 3 means the answer could not be grounded in the vault. The procedure doc says `--ask` exits with 0 only when the answer is anchored, either as a verbatim read or as verified quotes. In every other case it exits with 3.

ANSWER_PATH: 10_DOCUMENTATION/procedures/Connecting_Every_AI_To_The_Vault.md
ANSWER: "Iese cu 0 doar dacă răspunsul e ancorat (citire verbatim sau citate verificate), altfel cu 3." (It exits 0 only if the answer is grounded, otherwise 3.)
